zh.title: ArcFlow · 把审批，接进你的业务
zh.description: 面向 Java 业务系统的开源审批项目。用可视化设计器配置顺序审批，运行请假、采购、报价和报销示例，查看清晰的能力边界。
zh.intro:
从流程设计，到每一次审批。
用看得见、跑得通的示例，搭起你的业务流程。
zh.heroNote: Apache-2.0 · 源码预览 · 自托管示例
zh.screenSub: 选择节点，配置人员与审批方式。每一笔申请，保留提交时的流程。
zh.screenLabel: 真实界面 / 合成演示数据
proof: 安排步骤，设置 SINGLE / ALL / ANY
保存业务字段与流程版本快照
处理当前待办，保留每个人的决定
zh.designerIntro: 给审批步骤命名，选好参与人，再发布。流程变了，新申请用新版本；已提交的申请保留原样。
designerFeatures: 插入、删除、上下调整，保持每一步的先后关系。
单人处理、全员同意（ALL），或任一人同意（ANY）。
发布检查期望版本，提交保存步骤、人员与规则。
zh.flowNote: 示意流程 · 顺序步骤，非通用并行网关
zh.scenariosTitle:
从一笔真实业务，
走完整个流程。
zh.scenariosIntro: 四种可运行示例，各有明确范围。先体验，再决定怎么接进自己的系统。
zh.screenNote: 真实产品截图，使用合成数据；点击查看完整画面。

scenarios.title: 把每笔费用，说清楚。
scenarios.body: 成本中心、币种、1–20 行费用明细，连同审批流程一起保存。通过、驳回与逐人记录，都有迹可循。
scenarios.boundary: 票据引用为文字，不上传或验真；审批通过不会打款。当前未接入若依与 H5。
scenarios.alt: 费用报销工作区：包含成本中心、币种和多行费用明细的已填写表单

scenarios.title: 从请假，理解每一步。
scenarios.body: 填写整天天数和事由，由当前审批人处理，再进入后续复核。待办和记录随身份切换。
scenarios.boundary: 这是审批示例，不计算考勤或假期余额，也不支持自动寻找直属主管。
scenarios.alt: 请假审批待办：左侧申请列表，右侧当前审批、流程顺序和操作记录

scenarios.title: 让采购申请，有据可审。
scenarios.body: 物品、数量、单价与币种，随申请进入审批。需要审批的业务信息与当时的流程一起保留。
scenarios.boundary: 示例不自动下单、付款或入库；审批结果需要由宿主业务继续处理。
scenarios.alt: 采购申请表：单项物品、数量、单价和币种字段

scenarios.title: 报价有调整，决策有记录。
scenarios.body: 核对源报价与申请价格，依次由销售经理和财务审核。业务读权与审批权限分别检查。
scenarios.boundary: 与共享工作区隔离；未连接真实 CRM，不自动报价、通知客户或回写业务。
scenarios.alt: 独立 CRM 报价折扣申请页，展示源报价、申请价格和审批说明

zh.architectureTitle:
内核、审批、界面。
各自做好自己的事。
zh.architectureIntro: 从最小的 Java 内核，到可运行的宿主示例。你可以看清依赖，再选择适合自己的接入层。
layers: 01 / ENGINE
同步 DAG 内核
按依赖顺序运行处理器，管理变量与事件。内核无第三方运行时依赖。
不承载人工等待或持久运行状态。
02 / DOMAIN
审批领域与存储
人员权限、顺序步骤、快照与审批记录。默认 JSON，可选 JDBC 适配器。
审批模块有自身依赖；JDBC 需要显式接线与迁移。
03 / EXPERIENCE
宿主与客户端
Spring Boot、Vue、若依与 H5 示例，展示不同系统的接入方式。
各客户端覆盖范围不同，不代表完整生产服务。
zh.capTitle:
能做什么，
也说清还不能做什么。
zh.capIntro: 开源的价值，也在于边界透明。把缺项算进接入计划，而不是上线后再发现。
caps: 顺序审批与固定人员组
SINGLE、ALL、ANY；流程版本、申请快照、审批历史。
JSON 默认单写者；JDBC 需接线，客户端支持范围不同。
条件分支、动态主管、撤回、转办、定时催办、BPMN。
zh.startTitle:
下一步，
跑一笔自己的申请。
zh.startIntro: 在本地启动示例，用 Alice 发起、Bob 审批，再由 Carol 复核。先把整个过程走一遍。
zh.requirements: Linux / macOS / WSL · Git · Python 3.9+ · 完整 JDK 17+ · Maven 3.9+ · Node 22.22.2+（22.x，含 npm）
zh.terminalLabel: 终端 / 固定到本页功能基线
zh.copyFail: 无法访问剪贴板，请手动选择命令
zh.runNote: 首次运行需要联网下载依赖。等待终端显示就绪地址，从本次密码文件读取演示账号。Ctrl-C 会停止服务并删除本次试用数据；需要保留数据，请按手动启动说明操作。
versions: 包含报销工作区与能力目录。文案核对于 2026-10-09。
较早版本，提交 ab428327；不含报销等后续主线更新。
组合场景仍是候选预览，不作为本页已交付能力。
zh.closing:
把下一条流程，
交给你来定义。
zh.closingBody: 读源码，跑示例，告诉我们你的使用场景。
zh.star: 在 GitHub 上支持项目
zh.footerDisclosure: 本页为静态项目介绍，不提供在线审批服务。无追踪脚本、无数据收集表单。
zh.noJS: 页面内容和源码链接无需 JavaScript。开启 JavaScript 可切换场景与放大截图。

en.title: ArcFlow · Bring approvals into your business
en.description: An open-source approval project for Java applications. Configure sequential steps, run business examples, and explore clear capability boundaries.
en.intro:
From the first step to the final decision.
Build on examples you can see, run, and understand.
en.screenSub: Choose a node, its reviewers, and an approval mode. Every request keeps the workflow it started with.
proof: Set steps and SINGLE / ALL / ANY rules
en.designerIntro: Name the steps, choose the people, and publish. New requests use the new version. Existing requests keep the original.
designerFeatures: Insert, remove, and move steps while keeping a clear sequence.
One reviewer, everyone agrees (ALL), or anyone agrees (ANY).
Publishing checks the expected version; requests preserve their steps, people, and rules.
en.flowNote: Illustrative sequence · Not a general parallel gateway
en.scenariosIntro: Four runnable examples, each with an explicit scope. Try them before choosing how to integrate.
en.screenNote: Real product screenshots with synthetic data. Open an image to see it in full.

scenarios.title: Every expense, accounted for.
scenarios.body: A cost center, currency, and 1–20 expense lines, saved alongside the approval process. Follow decisions and individual review records.
scenarios.boundary: Receipt references are text, not uploads or validation. Approval never sends a payment. Not yet integrated with RuoYi or H5.
scenarios.alt: Completed expense form with cost center, currency, and multiple expense lines

scenarios.title: Start with a leave request.
scenarios.body: Enter whole days and a reason. The current reviewer makes a decision before the next step begins. Inbox and records follow the active identity.
scenarios.boundary: An approval example, without attendance calculations, leave balances, or automatic line-manager lookup.
scenarios.alt: Leave approval inbox with the request, current review step, workflow sequence, and history

scenarios.title: Give reviewers the details.
scenarios.body: An item, quantity, unit price, and currency travel with the request. Business details and the workflow are preserved as submitted.
scenarios.boundary: No automatic purchasing, payments, or inventory updates. The host business must handle the outcome.
scenarios.alt: Procurement request form for an item, quantity, unit price, and currency

scenarios.title: A price change with a record.
scenarios.body: Compare a source quote with the requested price, then review through sales management and finance. Business read access and approval rights are checked separately.
scenarios.boundary: Separate from the shared workspace. No live CRM connection, automatic quoting, customer notification, or business write-back.
scenarios.alt: Separate CRM quote-discount page with source quote, requested price, and review information

en.architectureTitle:
Engine. Domain. Interface.
Each with its own job.
en.architectureIntro: From a small Java engine to runnable host examples. See the dependencies, then choose the right layer for your application.
layers: 01 / ENGINE
Synchronous DAG engine
Runs handlers in dependency order, with variables and events. No third-party runtime dependencies in the core.
Does not manage human waits or persistent execution state.
02 / DOMAIN
Approvals and storage
Identity checks, sequential steps, snapshots, and history. JSON by default, with an optional JDBC adapter.
Has its own dependencies. JDBC needs explicit wiring and migrations.
03 / EXPERIENCE
Hosts and clients
Spring Boot, Vue, RuoYi, and H5 examples demonstrate different integration approaches.
Client coverage varies. Examples are not a production-readiness guarantee.
en.capTitle:
Clear about what works.
Honest about what’s next.
en.capIntro: Know the gaps before you integrate. Open source should make that easier, too.
caps: SINGLE, ALL, ANY; workflow versions, request snapshots, and approval history.
Default JSON is single-writer. JDBC requires wiring; client coverage differs.
Conditional branches, dynamic managers, withdrawal, delegation, timed reminders, and BPMN.
en.startTitle:
Next, run a request
of your own.
en.startIntro: Start locally. Submit as Alice, approve as Bob, then review as Carol. Walk through the whole process first.
en.requirements: Linux / macOS / WSL · Git · Python 3.9+ · Full JDK 17+ · Maven 3.9+ · Node 22.22.2+ (22.x, with npm)
en.copyFail: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the commands manually.
en.runNote: The first run downloads dependencies. Wait for the ready URLs and read demo accounts from this run’s password file. Ctrl-C stops the services and deletes this run’s data. Use the manual setup guide if you need to retain data.
versions: Includes the expense workspace and capability catalog. Checked on 2026-10-09.
Earlier commit ab428327. Excludes expenses and later main-branch updates.
Combined scenarios remain a candidate preview, not delivered capabilities on this page.
en.closingBody: Read the code, run an example, share your use case.
en.footerDisclosure: A static project website, not an online approval service. No tracking scripts or data collection forms.
en.noJS: Content and source links work without JavaScript. Enable it for scenario tabs and full-screen images.
